title: Maestro Flow Schema
description: Schema for Maestro flow YAML files

appId.description: The app ID to launch for testing

addMedia.description: List of media file paths to add to the device's gallery

start.description: Start coordinates for the swipe gesture. Can be in percentages (e.g., '90%, 50%') or absolute pixels (e.g., '100, 200').

end.description: End coordinates for the swipe gesture. Can be in percentages (e.g., '10%, 50%') or absolute pixels (e.g., '300, 400').

direction.description: Direction of the swipe gesture. Swiping starts from the center of the screen or the specified element.

id.description: ID of the element to swipe from.

text.description: Text of the element to swipe from.

from.description: Element to swipe from, specified using a selector.

duration.description: Duration of the swipe in milliseconds. Longer durations result in slower swipes. Defaults to 400 ms.

swipe.description: Command to perform swipe gestures with control over start and end points, direction, speed, and optional element targeting.

oneOf.description: The text to assert visibility for a single view with specific text.
The text to assert non-visibility for a single view with specific text.
A JavaScript expression to assert its truthiness.
A shorthand selector for text.

id.description: Matches element with the specified ID.

width.description: Matches element with the specified width.

height.description: Matches element with the specified height.

enabled.description: Matches element with the specified enabled state.

checked.description: Matches element with the specified checked state.

focused.description: Matches element with the specified focused state.

selected.description: Matches element with the specified selected state.

oneOf.description: Selector object to find the element.

visible.description: Waits until the element becomes visible.

inputText.description: Inputs the specified text regardless of whether any text field is currently focused. Unicode characters are not yet supported on Android.

inputRandomEmail.description: Inputs a randomly generated email address.

inputRandomPersonName.description: Inputs a randomly generated person name.

length.description: Specifies the length of the random number. Defaults to 8.

inputRandomNumber.description: Inputs a randomly generated number with an optional specified length.

length.description: Specifies the length of the random text. Defaults to 8.

inputRandomText.description: Inputs randomly generated unstructured text with an optional specified length.

killApp.description: Command to kill the app on Android, triggering a System-initiated Process Death. On iOS and Web, it is an alias for stopApp.

oneOf.description: Launches the app under test without additional configurations.

appId.description: Specifies the app ID (package name on Android, bundle ID on iOS) to launch.

clearState.description: Indicates whether to clear the app's state before launching. Defaults to false.

clearKeychain.description: Clears the entire iOS keychain. Applicable only for iOS.

stopApp.description: Stops the app before launching. Defaults to true.

all.description: Sets the permission state for all permissions.

additionalProperties.description: Sets the permission state (allow, deny, unset) for a specific permission.
Launch arguments as key-value pairs. Supports String, Boolean, Double, and Integer.

arguments.description: Additional arguments to pass while launching the app.

oneOf.description: Launches an app with the specified configuration.

launchApp.description: Command to launch the app under test or an arbitrary app with specified configurations.

oneOf.description: Opens the specified link on the device (i.e., a deep link).

link.description: The URL or deep link to open on the device.

autoVerify.description: Indicates whether to auto-verify the web link to open in your app. Defaults to false.

browser.description: Forces the link to open in the web browser on Android. Defaults to false.

oneOf.description: Opens a link on the device with additional options like auto-verification or browser preference.

openLink.description: Command to open a link (deep link or web link) on the device, with optional auto-verification and browser control.

pressKey.description: Command to press a specific key on the device or remote. Supports standard device keys and Android TV remote controls.

pasteText.description: Command to paste text copied with copyTextFrom into the currently focused field. Ensure the text field is in focus before using this command.

times.description: Number of times to repeat the commands.

id.description: Finds element with accessibility identifier matching the regular expression.

oneOf.description: Relative position on screen, e.g., '50%, 50%' for the middle of the screen.

height.description: Finds element of a given height.

tolerance.description: Tolerance to apply when comparing width and height.

id.description: Matches a view below another view with the specified ID.

above.description: Matches a view above another view with the specified ID.

leftOf.description: Matches a view to the left of another view with the specified text.

rightOf.description: Matches a view to the right of another view with the specified text.

oneOf.description: Detailed selector object for the element.

element.description: Selector for the element to scroll until visible.

direction.description: Direction to scroll. Defaults to DOWN.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds to scroll and look for the element. Defaults to 20000.

visibilityPercentage.description: Percentage of the element visible in the viewport to consider as visible. Defaults to 100.

centerElement.description: Indicates whether to center the element when it becomes visible. Defaults to false.

scrollUntilVisible.description: Command to scroll towards a direction until the specified element becomes visible.

latitude.description: The latitude of the location to set. Must be a value between -90 and 90.

longitude.description: The longitude of the location to set. Must be a value between -180 and 180.

setLocation.description: Command to apply a mock geolocation to the device. Note: This works only on Android API level 31 or above.

startRecording.description: Command to start a screen recording. The value specifies the name of the recording file.

oneOf.description: Command to initiate a screen recording and save it with the specified name in the same directory as the test flow.

stopRecording.description: Command to stop a running screen recording.

oneOf.description: Command to stop a screen recording that was previously started with startRecording.
